impossibility_at_prior_capacity.claim: Even source plus immutable resident weights exceeds old live capacity; no source/graph/backend cap reduction can honestly admit it under that observed pressure. CPU jobs must also obey current capacity.

Reduce only named host/job/dataset ceilings for the tiny authored classifier-only workload, with independent allocations enforced. Initial-bound fits; actual selected graph/tape/update bound must still pass without mutation. No guarantee of stage fit or currently available physical capacity. No workload/candidate/model/dropout change.
